title: Putting it together
intro: Two capstone queries combine most of the language, followed by exercises and a free playground.

steps.question: Who funded each interviewed artist, or their works?
steps.query:
find distinct Artist, Funder, Work
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  either
    funded_by(Artist, Funder)
  or
    created_by(Work, Artist)
    funded_by(Work, Funder)
order by Artist, Funder, Work
notes: Funding is sometimes recorded against the artist and sometimes against a specific work. `either`/`or` collects both, and `Work` stays `null` for artist-level funding.

steps.question: For every work by an interviewed artist dated 1970 to 1989, what media and venues are recorded, and which transcript should I check?
steps.query:
find Year, Artist, Work, Medium, Venue, Url
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Year)
  Year between @1970 and @1989
  interviewee(Interview, Artist)
  source_url(Interview, Url)
  optional
    uses_medium(Work, Medium)
  optional
    exhibited_at(Work, Venue)
order by Year, Artist, Work, Medium, Venue
notes: One query: an entity-type filter, a four-step chain, a range comparison, two independent optional blocks and ordering. A work appears once per combination of medium and venue.
Remember what the result is: claims extracted from interviews, with the transcript each artist's claims came from.

steps.heading: Exercises
steps.question: Which institutions did George Barber study at?
steps.solution:
find Place
where
  educated_at(george_barber, Place)
order by Place

steps.question: Which interviewed artists are recorded as collaborating with `david_hall`?
steps.solution:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  collaborated_with(Artist, david_hall)
order by Artist

steps.question: Which three interviewed artists have the most recorded collaborators?
steps.solution:
find Artist, count(Person)
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  collaborated_with(Artist, Person)
order by count(Person) descending, Artist
limit 3

steps.question: Which works were commissioned, by whom, and who made them?
steps.solution:
find Artist, Work, Commissioner
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  commissioned_by(Work, Commissioner)
order by Artist, Work, Commissioner

steps.heading: Playground
steps.question: Ask your own question.
steps.query:
find Artist, Institution
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  employed_by(Artist, Institution)
order by Artist
notes: Use the predicate list and Describe from the first lessons to find what you need.

For the complete language, see the [query language reference](https://github.com/jptmoore/beingdb/blob/main/docs/query-language.md). To install BeingDB and work with the full archive, see the [native tutorial](https://github.com/jptmoore/beingdb/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md).
